title: WhatsApp
description: Choose a WhatsApp delivery provider, manage message templates, and monitor the delivery log.

provider.title: Delivery provider
provider.body: A school can use the Meta Cloud API directly, or its own local gateway. Tokens and keys are never displayed again after being saved.
provider.activeHint: While disabled, WhatsApp notifications fall back to the server's default configuration.

meta.accessTokenPlaceholderSet: Saved — leave blank to keep this token

gateway.urlHint: The school's own WhatsApp gateway endpoint.
gateway.headerValuePlaceholderSet: Saved — leave blank to keep this value

templates.title: Message templates
templates.body: Each template maps to a template already approved in WhatsApp Business Manager. Wrap a variable name in double curly braces to create a placeholder.

form.bodyHint: Example: Hello parent_name, the amount payment is due on due_date (wrap each in double curly braces).

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.body: Every WhatsApp send attempt, successful or not, is recorded here.
